title: Build a Better Freight Business
description: A practical approach to sales, operations and modern tools for companies that move freight.

registration.consentText: By registering, you request a confirmation email with your training-page link.

learningPoints.title: Find and win the right customers
learningPoints.description: Connect your positioning, prospecting and follow-up into a more consistent sales process.

learningPoints.title: Strengthen the way you operate
learningPoints.description: Use clearer processes and responsibilities to support your team and the customers you serve.

learningPoints.title: Make modern tools useful
learningPoints.description: Identify where technology and automation can help with the work your business already does.

learningPoints.title: Choose your next growth opportunity
learningPoints.description: Consider additional services and freight modes in the context of your customers, capabilities and goals.

challenges.title: Unclear positioning
challenges.description: You need a clearer way to explain who you serve and why a customer should choose your business.

challenges.title: Inconsistent prospecting
challenges.description: Outreach and follow-up happen when you find the time, instead of following a repeatable process.

challenges.title: Too much manual work
challenges.description: Repeated tasks and scattered information leave less time for customers and business development.

challenges.title: Limited service options
challenges.description: You see opportunities in additional freight modes but need to understand what serving them requires.

challenges.title: Little visibility into performance
challenges.description: You need a better way to see what is happening in sales and operations, and where to improve.

challenges.title: No clear next priority
challenges.description: There are plenty of tools and ideas to consider. Choosing what deserves your attention is the hard part.
